author: Ari Koslow
title: Dylan Beavers (oblique) to begin rehab assignment Thursday
desc: Dylan Beavers will begin a rehab assignment on Thursday with Double-A Chesapeake.
impact: Beavers should be activated from the injured list by the end of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Bassitt (back) begins throwing progression
desc: Chris Bassitt has started a throwing progression.
impact: Bassitt is on the injured list with lower back discomfort. It is unclear how much longer he'll be sidelined for.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Raley dealing with back injury
desc: Luke Raley is day-to-day with back tightness.
impact: Raley will be further evaluated into Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Harris II suffers back injury Tuesday
desc: Michael Harris II was removed from Tuesday's game against the Giants with lower back tightness.
impact: Harris will be further evaluated on Wednesday. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani to start Wednesday
desc: Shohei Ohtani will start Wednesday's series finale against the Rays.
impact: Ohtani threw a bullpen session on Tuesday without any issues. It is unclear if he'll be in the lineup.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Maikel Garcia suffers hand injury Tuesday
desc: Maikel Garcia was removed from Tuesday's game against the Nationals with left hand soreness.
impact: Garcia will head to be further evaluated. He is day-to-day heading into Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Arozarena (hamstring) placed on IL
desc: The Mariners placed OF Randy Arozarena on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain.
impact: Arozarena had been hopeful to just miss a few days, but he instead lands on the injured list. He is without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Curtis Washington has contract selected by Mariners
desc: The Mariners selected the contract of OF Curtis Washington Jr. from High-A Everett.
impact: Washington is an emergency call-up on the bench for Seattle. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colt Keith scratched from lineup Tuesday
desc: Colt Keith has been scratched from the lineup for the Detroit Tigers due to right wrist soreness according to Chris McCosky.
impact: Kerry Carpenter will move into the designated hitter role and bat third while Wenceel Perez takes Carpenter's spot in right field while batting sixth for manager AJ Hinch against the Astros.

author: Ari Koslow
title: J.P. Crawford to start at third base Tuesday
desc: J.P. Crawford is getting the start at third base on Tuesday.
impact: Crawford was taking reps at third base prior to landing on the injured list. Colt Emerson will remain at shortstop.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Verlander (hip) to return and start Sunday
desc: Justin Verlander will start on Sunday against the White Sox.
impact: Verlander was able to throw a successful sim game on Monday. His upside will remain limited for fantasy managers early on in his return from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Donovan (groin) starting running program
desc: Brendan Donovan is preparing to start a 10-12 day running program.
impact: If all goes well, Donovan will start a rehab assignment in late June or early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Marco Gonzales released by Padres
impact: Gonzales posted a 7.99 ERA in 47 1/3 innings in the minor leagues this season. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Naylor (wrist) day-to-day
impact: Naylor is not in the lineup on Tuesday against the Orioles. He'll be day-to-day heading into Wednesday.
